ar.title: باتيه الشكشوكة

steps.n1: تدهن صينية بالسمن وتوضع نصف كمية الجلاش بعد دهنه خفيفا بالسمن.
steps.n2: توضع الشكشوكة عليه ثم يغطى بالنصف الآخر للجلاش، وفوقه ملعقة كبيرة سمن، ويقطَع.
steps.n3: يدخل فرن متوسط الحرارة حتى يحمر الوجه.
steps.n4: بعد النضج يسقى بكوب اللبن البارد المتبل بالملح والفلفل ويترك حتى يتشرب، ثم يغطى ويطفأ الفرن.

en.title: Phyllo Pie with Shakshuka Filling

steps.n1: Grease a baking tray with ghee and layer half of the phyllo pastry, lightly brushing each layer with ghee.
steps.n2: Spread the shakshuka over the pastry, cover with the remaining half of the phyllo, top with 1 tablespoon of ghee, and cut into pieces.
steps.n3: Place in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.
steps.n4: Once cooked, pour the cold milk (seasoned with salt and pepper) over the pastry and let it soak up the liquid, then cover it and turn off the oven.

legacySteps: Grease a baking tray with ghee and layer half of the phyllo pastry, lightly brushing each layer with ghee.
Spread the shakshuka over the pastry, cover with the remaining half of the phyllo, top with 1 tablespoon of ghee, and cut into pieces.
Place in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.
Once cooked, pour the cold milk (seasoned with salt and pepper) over the pastry and let it soak up the liquid, then cover it and turn off the oven.
